# The Python tests that need a real Mac: macOS Seatbelt, a case-insensitive file system (APFS's default), or a
# vendor's own CLI on the PATH (codex, grok and agy; Muse through NEXUS_TEST_MUSE_BINARY). They run only in the nightly
# python-native job on the macOS fleet runner; server-policy runs every other test on each PR. A test lives in exactly
# one of the two. .github/python-tests.py reads this file: a row naming a test that does not exist fails the run, and so
# does any skip. None of these tests needs a key or a sign-in: they use fixture tokens, a local fixture issuer on
# 127.0.0.1, or a login started in a clean home and abandoned.
#
# <start directory> <unittest id>
